sections.shortTitle: Zakat and Ushr Third Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XCV OF 1996
ORDINANCE XCV OF 1996
ZAKAT AND USHR (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1996
An Ordinance further to amend the Zakat and
Ushr Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980 (XVIII of 1980), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short
title and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance tray be called the Zakat and
Ushr (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

following Ordinance:‑‑
8. Substitution of section 15, Ordinance XVIII
of 1980.‑‑In
the said Ordinance, for section 15, the following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"15. Regional Administrator.‑‑(1)
For carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance, in each region and ‑the
Islamabad Capital Territory, the Federal Government may appoint Regional
Administrators from amongst the members of a regularly constituted Federal or
Provincial Civil Service.
(2) The administrative organization of Regional
Administrator shall consist of such officers and staff recruited directly or
otherwise as may be determined by the Federal Government.
(3) The Regional Administrator shall function
under the administrative and financial control of the Zakat and Ushr Division.
(4) The Regional Administrator may receive and
dispose of complaints regarding non‑disbursement, irregular disbursement
of Zakat and Ushr and also receive requests for payment of Zakat. ".

13. Insertion of section 18A, Ordinance XVIII
of 1980.‑‑In
the said Ordinance, after section 18, the following new section shall be
inserted, namely:‑‑
"18A. Union Council, Town Committee,
Municipal and Cantonment Wards Area Committees.‑‑(1) There shall be
a Zakat and Ushr Committee, hereinafter referred to as the Committee, for the
.area of each Union Council, Town Committee, Municipal and Cantonment Wards:
Provided that there shall be as many Committees
for the urban area of Islamabad as is the number of members nominated for that
area under proviso to clause (b) of subsection (3) of section 16:
Provided further that the District Committee
may, where it considers necessary, re‑delineate the areas of one or more
committees and constitute additional committees.
(2) Each Committee referred to in subsection
(1) shall consist of‑-
(a) a Chairman, who shall be nominated by the
Chairman of the District Committee;
(b) Chairmen of Local Committees; and
(c) up to three additional members including
one woman to be nominated by the Chairman of the District Committee.
(3) The Chairman and members of the Committee
shall hold office for a term of three years and shall also be eligible for re‑appointment:
Provided that the District Committee may, in
consultation with the Federal Government dissolve all or any of the Committees
and reconstitute the new Committees for the unexpired term of such Committees.
(4) The Committees referred to in subsection
(1) shall, subject to such guidelines as may be given by the Central Council or
District Committee,‑‑
(a) oversee assessment of Ushr and collection
of Zakat, Ushr, Attiyat and the disbursement and utilization of the moneys by
the Local Committees from the Local Zakat Fund;
(b) tender advice to the District Committee on
any matter connected with the collection disbursement or utilization of Zakat
and Ushr.".

Committee, Municipal and Ward Areas Committee, by the member elected by the
members present.".
